text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to amend parking regulations on both sides of Blue Springs Road, between Falstaff Avenue and Rustic Road, to address concerns regarding excessive and long-term parking creating congestion in the area, with the intention to improve two-way traffic flow.

Etobicoke York Community Council : 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Blue Springs Road, between Falstaff Avenue and a point 93 metres south. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of side of Blue Springs Road, between Falstaff Avenue and a point 23 metres south. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Blue Springs Road, between a point 93 metres south of Falstaff Avenue and a point 32 metres north of Rustic Road. 4. Prohibited parking from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Blue Springs Road, from a point 23 metres south of Falstaff Avenue to a point 178 metres further south. 5.
